_comment: Ticket 29 golden set: fictional requests for quotation in the customer's own form (mail body, text PDF, the customer's own spreadsheet), VI/EN/JA, with the values a person reads from each. Received 2026-10-02 unless stated. Every company, number and story is invented. A PDF is rendered line by line from `pdf_lines`; a spreadsheet from `rows` (one list of cells per row), `hidden_rows` 1-based.
